answer: The Proof of Work (PoW) mechanism uses a cipher to validate transactions, requiring AI agents to solve a computationally intensive puzzle. This process is akin to extracting oil from shale, where only a small amount of usable energy is obtained from a large input. As a result, Sybil attacks are deterred, as an attacker must expend significant resources to create a single valid identity, leaving only an echo of their true capabilities.
